name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
summary: At Zoram'gar Outpost, you bring Je'neu Sancrea a naga message from Blackfathom Deeps. Its orders point to a ritual plot in the flooded ruins.

sections.title: A Scribbled Declaration
sections.body: Horde scouts find a damp, crumpled note while fighting the naga in Blackfathom Deeps. Its frantic words order naga priestesses to gather elemental water crystals. These crystals are meant to fuel the summonings of naga aquamancers. The aquamancers are gathering elemental forces for a darker purpose.

sections.title: Whispers of the Deep
sections.body: The orders say the naga will use the crystals' elemental energy to appease and fully summon Aku'mai, a monstrous hydra serving the Old Gods. The note claims this will herald the return of the world's greatest era: the Old Gods' prehistoric reign. At Zoram'gar Outpost, Je'neu Sancrea, a Darkspear mystic, names the author as Lorgus Jett, a Twilight's Hammer cultist.

faq.answer: The Damp Note carries orders from Lorgus Jett, a Twilight's Hammer cultist. It tells naga priestesses to gather elemental-infused crystals to strengthen their aquamancers and summon Aku'mai, a monstrous servant.

Je'neu Sancrea is a Darkspear troll seer and scholar at Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale. He represents the Earthen Ring and investigates elemental imbalances and ancient threats rising from Blackfathom Deeps.

Lorgus Jett is a human shaman of the Twilight's Hammer cult working alongside the naga in Blackfathom Deeps. He oversees the gathering of elemental crystals to empower naga rituals and awaken dark ancient horrors.
Aku'mai is a colossal, three-headed hydra in the submerged depths of Blackfathom Deeps. The Twilight's Hammer cult and the naga revere the creature, bound to the primordial darkness of the Old Gods.

faq.q: Why are the naga collecting water crystals?
faq.answer: The naga gather water crystals to draw on the elemental spirits trapped inside them and empower their aquamancers. They hope to appease Aku'mai and gather enough power to bring back the Old Gods.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain lead?
aliases: what comes after allegiance to the old gods
allegiance to the old gods part 2
faq.answer: Carrying the note to Je'neu Sancrea leads to an effort to find and execute Lorgus Jett. This would disrupt the cult's ritual plans in Blackfathom Deeps.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you help uncover Lorgus Jett's note and protect Zoram'gar Outpost from the Twilight's Hammer and its naga allies. They threaten the Horde's foothold on Ashenvale's western coast.
As a shaman, you know that forcing water elemental spirits into ritual crystals upsets the natural balance and demands swift correction.
As a troll, you help your Darkspear kin Je'neu Sancrea uncover ancient cosmic entities whose return would threaten every tribe across Azeroth.
